name: protomated-plugins-official
description: Protomated plugin marketplace — Claude plugins for solo attorneys

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum && npm run deploy:artifact
scripts.release: npm run release:check && git tag v$npm_package_version && git push origin v$npm_package_version
scripts.tree: find solo-attorney-starter-kit new-matter-organizer engagement-letter-drafter court-deadline-calendar billing-narrative-drafter meeting-prep-brief legal-billing-tracker -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort
